summary: State-machine iterator that yields the next node of a tree/container traversal one step at a time. Maintains three states on this+0x0 (0=init, 1=sibling-descend, 2=child-iterate) and a done flag on this+0x4. Advances a current item at this+0x8 along sibling next-pointers at item+140 and child lists under the parent at this+0x10, with container state at this+0xC. When exhausted, sets the done flag and returns; otherwise returns the current item pointer. Called from rendering tree traversal by RenderingContextSetup (0x00497750) and sub_4998E0 (0x004998E0).

local_names.this: tree traversal iterator state object (state, done flag, item, container, parent)
local_names.v2: return value (current item pointer or done status)
local_names.v5: next node pointer read from parent+76 during sibling descent
local_names.v8: container sibling-list head pointer during re-init
local_names.v10: first sibling node selected during re-init

operations.description: Early exit: when the done flag this+0x4 is set, clears the current item at this+0x8 and returns immediately (traversal already complete)
Main state-machine loop: repeats dispatching on this+0x0 until a node is yielded, the iteration is exhausted, or the done flag becomes set
When a current item exists at this+0x8, advances it to the next pointer stored at item+140 (0x8C)
State dispatch on this+0x0: value 0 means re-init (container head check), value 1 enters sibling-descend, value 2 enters child-iterate

Sibling-descend (state 1): reads the parent from this+0x10, transitions to state 2, reads the child-list head at parent+72 into this+0x14 and, when non-null, the first child item at child-head+68 into this+0x8
Child-iterate (state 2): LinkedListNodeTraversal_98c0 decides whether sibling iteration continues; on true, fetches the next sibling at child-head+68 (0x44) into this+0x8
LinkedListIteratorAdvance advances the sibling iterator; when it reports failure the traversal has no more children and proceeds to the done/return path
After a successful iterator advance, sets the state back to 1 (sibling-descend) and reads the next sibling node at parent+76 (0x4C) from the parent at this+0x10 into this+0x8
Loop tail: if the done flag this+0x4 is clear and the current item this+0x8 is non-null, returns the item; otherwise continues the loop or returns the done status

Re-initialization path (state 0): reads the container's sibling-list head at container+4, copies it into container+12 (0xC), sets state 1, selects the first sibling at sibling+76 (0x4C) into this+0x8 and clears the child pointer this+0x14; when the head is null the done flag this+0x4 is set
Invoked by RenderingContextSetup (0x00497750) and sub_4998E0 (0x004998E0) as the per-step node iterator during rendering tree traversal
